procedures_performed: Chest radiograph, PA and lateral views
fields.discharge_instructions: 1. Complete oral amoxicillin-clavulanate 625 mg three times daily for 5 more days. 2. Check blood glucose twice daily and continue metformin 500 mg twice daily. 3. Return to the Emergency Department if fever above 38.5°C, shortness of breath or chest pain. 4. Follow up at the Respiratory Clinic in 2 weeks with a repeat chest X-ray.
